changes.after: After withdrawing from the bead, we press the large button marked REPLAY. It clears the paper and restores the stored paths.

That is a fact about our selection, not evidence that the group deserved it.

The five figures are still there when we turn away. We have kept a result; the procedure that made it remains out of view.

changes.before: Its screen shows 435. So does the colour window, and a capture beside the virtual lamps.
changes.after: The cabinet's screen shows a number that has also been kept: 435. So does the colour window, and a capture beside the virtual lamps.

changes.before: A generator began from 435, advanced its internal state, and supplied numbers from which the intervals were made.
changes.after: 435 is the seed, the number that set the generator's starting state. The calculation then advanced that state, supplying numbers from which the intervals were made.

changes.before: The cabinet has another way of reading the intervals. We keep the ninety-six events fixed and make the comparison clock coarser. Two gaps that had different durations may now receive the same measured value. The bit extractor skips such a pair.
changes.after: The cabinet has another way of reading the intervals. It compares pairs of gaps to produce bits, zeros or ones. We keep the ninety-six events fixed and make the comparison clock coarser, measuring in larger steps. Two gaps that had different durations may now receive the same measured value. Such a pair is skipped.

changes.before: We can hear the gaps once more. Listening cannot restore the bit that this particular comparison declined to produce.
changes.after: We can hear the gaps once more. For this comparison, the tied pair still yields no bit.

changes.reason: Describe the transformation without requiring hash vocabulary
changes.before: The apparatus has kept more than the number. There is a timed series of poses. These measurements are rounded, encoded and hashed by a fixed procedure, then reduced to one of a thousand possible seeds.
changes.after: The apparatus has kept more than the number: positions and orientations recorded over time. A fixed calculation turns the rounded measurements into a whole number, then reduces it to one of a thousand possible seeds.

changes.after: We take hold and join an excursion already under way. This time the viewpoint moves.
